findings.title: T015 requires remote GitHub Actions proof despite the explicit prohibition on contacting or updating remotes
T010 treats exact lint guidance and operator-owned lint fixes as alternatives even though the constraints require both
T001, T006, and T010 are not bootstrap prerequisites, so other tasks may encounter duplicate jobs, stale code, and unactionable rework before those safeguards land
Mandatory operator hand-offs and T002's reproduce-before-fix pause have no explicit task phase or blocker before automatic verification and rework
T008 can pass while still recording last_status as failed because its focused criterion checks only consecutive_failures
T005 and T013 do not name their required offline focused harnesses in verification_commands, leaving independent execution unplanned
docs/install.md has no explicit documentation owner despite T004 changing the semantics of its prescribed release-day rehearsal
